import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { ListingDetail, ShelfItem } from '~/types/catalog'

function escapeJson(json: string): string {
  return json.replace(/</g, '\\u003c').replace(/>/g, '\\u003e')
}

export function useStructuredDataHome(items: Ref<ShelfItem[]>) {
  const { apiUrl } = useRuntimeConfig().public

  function resolveImage(path: string | null): string {
    if (!path) return '/images/placeholder.jpg'
    return path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${apiUrl}${path}`
  }

  const schema = computed(() =>
    items.value.map((item) => ({
      '@type': 'ItemList',
      name: item.title,
      image: resolveImage(item.imagePath),
    })),
  )

  return { schema }
}

export function useStructuredDataListing(listing: Ref<ListingDetail | null>) {
  const { apiUrl } = useRuntimeConfig().public

  function resolveImage(path: string | null): string {
    if (!path) return '/images/placeholder.jpg'
    return path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${apiUrl}${path}`
  }

  function formatCurrency(value: number): string {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(value)
  }

  const schema = computed(() => {
    const l = listing.value
    if (!l) return null

    const offers = l.prices.map((price) => ({
      '@type': 'Offer',
      description: price.monthly ? `${formatCurrency(price.amount)}/month` : formatCurrency(price.amount),
    }))

    return {
      '@type': 'Product',
      name: l.title,
      image: l.images.map((img) => resolveImage(img.filePath)),
      offers,
      json: escapeJson(JSON.stringify(offers)),
    }
  })

  return { schema }
}
